Retest After Disapproval

A.77

Retesting after failure of a knowledge or practical test

Standard CFI signoff No expiration
14 CFR § 61.49
AC 61-65K verbatim · AC page A-21

In the case of a failed knowledge test, the instructor may complete the endorsement in the space provided at the bottom of the applicant’s Airman Knowledge Test Report (AKTR). The instructor must sign the block provided for the instructor’s recommendation on the reverse side of FAA Form 8710-1, Airman Certificate and/or Rating Application, for each retake of a practical test. I certify that [First name, MI, Last name] has received the additional [flight and/or ground, as appropriate] training as required by 14 CFR § 61.49. I have determined that they are proficient to pass the [name of] knowledge/practical test.

  • After a failure, the FAA wants proof the weak areas were corrected first.
  • Helps target added training to the actual deficiencies, not just repeat the test.
  • Supports a safer and more meaningful retest.
